obligations.text: `repo` lists, adds, changes, enables, disables and deletes repositories, and lists the modules they hold.
obligations.cases: each subcommand vs the repository definitions before
obligations.observation: repository definitions; which repositories later commands use
obligations.gap: Only the effect of the Enabled flag on install selection is proved (repo_install_enabled_only); Main.cls::Repository add/modify/delete/list/-list-modules have no model (iter22 reinstall.rs uses delete/disable only as fixture steps). Contrast: `repo -n r -delete` then `repo -list` no longer shows r and install no longer resolves from it; `repo -n r -disable` keeps the definition listed.

obligations.cases: each credential source vs inline password
obligations.gap: No model of credential sourcing (Repo/*/Definition.cls command handling); iter2 registry.rs treats credentials as booleans. Contrast: `-token-env T` stores the value of $T, and an unset variable is refused.

obligations.text: Intended: -publish 1 marks the repository that publishing goes to (only flagged repositories receive publishes without -repo).
obligations.cases: flag holder vs no holder vs older unflagged remote
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70 (proved under PH, PU, PK; F-REPO-3 witness: with no flag holder a token-only remote is used; row-order witness: an older unflagged remote wins over the holder); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m130; control playbook-uplift/models/verus/controls/settings.json impl-flag-ranked-last, l1-publish-any-enabled-b (results/settings.json: killed))

obligations.text: -copy-from copies repository settings from another namespace.
obligations.cases: copy from a namespace with definitions vs none
obligations.observation: repository definitions in the current namespace
obligations.gap: No model of -copy-from in Main.cls::Repository. Contrast: `repo -copy-from USER` in NS2 yields NS2 definitions equal to USER's, and later edits in USER do not change NS2 (copy, not mapping).

obligations.text: IPM 0.9 and later does not enable the community registry by default on a new installation.
obligations.gap: Installer repository seeding (preload/cls/IPM/Installer.cls:114) is not modeled; ns_mapping.rs::installer sets no rows. Contrast: `repo -list` after a fresh install shows no pm.community.intersystems.com entry.

obligations.text: `repo -r -n registry -url https://pm.community.intersystems.com/` or `enable -community` adds the community registry.
obligations.gap: Only enable -community is modeled, and only as "the source database has registry rows" (reset_repos), not the community URL. `repo -r -n registry -url ...` is not modeled. Contrast: after either command `repo -list` shows a remote named registry with that URL.
